---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new scientific method for CCS EEG Studio
labels: enhancement
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear description of what problem or missing feature you encountered.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear description of the new analysis method, visualization, or format reader you would like added.

**Research or clinical use case**
How this helps your EEG, ERP, microstate, or connectivity workflow.

**Reference implementation or publication (if any)**
Author, year, paper title, DOI, or link to reference code (e.g. MNE-Python, EEGLAB, FieldTrip).

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds you currently use.
